messages:
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@fastretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: launch-ops@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Launch forecast + capacity ask for Aug 14 promo

Hi Evelyn,

Quick context: FastRetail is running a nationwide summer promo on Aug 14 that drives spikes in personalization and search. Our engineering team expects a 12-hour peak window starting 15:00 UTC where requests to Redwood for personalization scoring and chat-based recommendations will spike.

Ask: Can Redwood provision a temporary rate-limit/quota increase for the account and confirm expected p95 latency under the increase? Our preliminary forecast (attached) shows the following peak expectations:
- Concurrent users: 18k
- Peak qps to Redwood: 4,200 requests/sec
- Avg tokens per request: 170 (in+out)
- Expected sustained peak duration: 12 hours

We'd appreciate:
1) A proposed temporary quota + rate-limit config we can rely on during the promo
2) Any required model fallbacks or redlines we should accept
3) Expected per-token cost impact and any recommended caching tweaks

I've attached the forecast and a PNG with simulated traffic. Can we lock this down by EOD Aug 3? We're trying to finalize our launch runbook.

Thanks — Miguel
Miguel Torres
Senior Product Ops, FastRetail

Attachments: fastretail_launch_forecast_v2.xlsx (xlsx), FastRetail_Launch_TRAFFIC.png (png)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T13:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Launch forecast + capacity ask for Aug 14 promo

Evelyn,

Quick infra read: 4.2k rps at ~170 tokens/request -> ~714k tokens/sec peak. On current Dedicated clusters we can support this if we:
- Temporarily increase their concurrency ceiling to 6k concurrent streams on the us-east pool
- Enable aggressive batching for small windowed requests (we can suggest client-side batching param)
- Pre-warm KV/prefix cache for known Top SKUs to reduce model compute (they provided SKUs — we should prime cache)

Constraints and risks:
- p95 latency estimate: 280–350ms on our optimized 40-seq paths if routed to the high-throughput pool; 450ms+ if they hit fallback/quantized models
- Risk: sustained 12-hour load may need burst capacity if upstream traffic deviates (+30% realized vs forecast)

Config I'll propose:
- Temporary rate-limit: 5k rps hard limit for Aug 14 14:00–02:00 UTC
- Auto-fallback: if compute backlog >30s, route 25% of requests to cost-optimized quantized variant and return X-Rate-Limited header advising degraded mode

I'll draft the infra playbook and the rollback command set by EOD Aug 2.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Sr. Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
